source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Record the date and time of the safety check.
3. Write down the type of appliance, brand, model, and serial number.
4. Document the specific safety check procedures followed.
5. Record the name of the technician performing the check.
6. Note any issues identified during the safety check.
   A. Lack of grounding
   B. Damaged power cords or plugs
   C. Overheating components
   D. Faulty switches
   E. Broken or loose parts
   F. Inadequate insulation
   G. Signs of arcing or burning
   H. Non-functioning safety devices (e.g., circuit breakers)
   I. Other significant mechanical defects
7. For each issue identified, provide a clear and detailed description.
8. Take photographs of the defects, if possible.
9. Complete the checklist with the status as "Failed" if any critical safety issues are found.
10. Sign off the
